records.title: AGPO: Adaptive Group Policy Optimization with Dual Statistical Feedback
records.reason: AGPO is an adaptive group policy optimization algorithm evaluated as a reinforcement-learning training method. The full text focuses on training feedback/statistics and does not propose an inference-time or serving efficiency method.

records.title: ProCrit: Self-Elicited Multi-Perspective Reasoning with Critic-Guided Revision for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
records.reason: ProCrit is a critic-guided multi-agent reasoning method for multimodal sarcasm detection, evaluated for task accuracy. Its added reasoning agents are a task-quality contribution rather than a demonstrated LLM inference efficiency improvement.

records.title: Parallel Context Modeling for Sliding Window Attention in Neural Video Coding
records.reason: The full text develops parallel context modeling to reduce decoding latency in a neural video-coding entropy model. It is not an LLM, but it has an autoregressive attention/parallel-decoding mechanism that may merit limited comparison with the linked sliding-window attention lineage; transfer to LLM decoding is not established.

records.title: Q-ARVD: Quantizing Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models
records.reason: Q-ARVD quantizes autoregressive video diffusion models for resource-constrained video generation and reports inference-efficiency aims. The full text is specifically about diffusion/video-generation model quantization, not large language model inference or the linked language-model serving lineage.
